title: Saber: free Goodnotes alternative
caption:
Goodnotes charges $11.99/year for handwritten notes. Saber does it for free ✍️

✅ Real handwriting, with a highlighter that never fades your ink
✅ Import PDFs and photos and mark them up
✅ Sync across devices, encrypted with your own password
✅ No subscription, nested folders with no limit

💻 iPad · iPhone · Android · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ Saber's sync runs through a Nextcloud account (Saber's server or your own), and there's no dedicated Mac build. Goodnotes also has a free plan (3 files, 5 MB imports); $11.99/year is its cheapest paid plan (Essential)

Comment "NOTES" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
